prompt:
USE CASE: stylized-concept. Create one isolated static transparent environment sprite for Warwrit.

SUBJECT: One ruined rural watermill building: rough grey stone walls, a partly collapsed shingle roof exposing snapped timber rafters, and its broken wooden waterwheel attached on the left. Clearly abandoned, damaged and non-operational. The yard cellar hatch is a separate ground prop: do not invent or paint a surrounding yard to include it.

FRAMING: Full building and entire wheel visible, centered with generous clear margins. Three-quarter view showing the front and left wheel side; upright verticals, credible adult-scale doors and practical rural construction. Place the base on a common low baseline. This is a static illustration example; its view must be matched to the consuming scene before production.

ART DIRECTION: Restrained graphic novel; serious grounded dark fantasy. Draw with confident irregular ink contours on major forms, broad matte flat washes and coherent shadow masses. Suggest wear through a few purposeful marks. Keep most stone, wood, foliage and ground surfaces quiet. Use desaturated slate, soot, umber, muted ochre and restrained moss olive. This must read as authored ink-and-wash illustration, with deliberate shape design rather than photographic surface detail.

SHAPE AND DETAIL: Readable roof damage, wheel opening and doorway are the focal features. Use broad connected shadow planes and economical interior lines. Keep small stone joints, roof shingles and timber grain subordinate. Each material is recognizable from a few marks. The silhouette must stay clear when reduced, with no clipped rafters or wheel edges.

LIGHT AND MATERIAL: Soft upper-left light, a readable matte midtone on the front wall and connected dark recesses under the roof. Restrained warm-grey stone and umber timber. No rim glow or bright white edge. Preserve one consistent light direction.

TRANSPARENCY: Genuine alpha-transparent background. Outside the building and attached wheel must be fully transparent; keep opaque structural surfaces solid and actual gaps between rafters or spokes transparent. No sky, landscape, stream, floor plane, ground tile, scenic vignette, cast shadow outside the object, painted white/grey backdrop, checkerboard or feathered matte halo.

REFERENCE RULE: If approved Warwrit reference images are supplied, use them for rendering language, palette and material character. The subject brief controls identity and condition. Do not reproduce an unrelated reference's layout, additional objects or fine surface noise.

EXCLUSIONS: No text, labels, runes, emblems, watermark, border, collage, UI, decorative fantasy castle, cute rounded architecture, pristine masonry, saturated orange foliage, glossy CGI, photographic texture, all-over grain, dense crosshatching or repeated tiny highlights. Do not add people, creatures, props or story facts not requested.

DELIVERY: One sprite, requested square canvas 1024x1024, no sprite sheet or variants. Preserve complete object bounds and a natural irregular base. The transparency flag is enabled; actual alpha and anchor placement must be checked after generation.
